rv.q: While the story is slight, it’s told with propulsive energy and a hint of bitter wit. Juliana Nash’s music doesn’t have a great deal of variety, and the characterisation in Julia Jordan’s book is thin, but the mood is undeniably passionate, and director SamYates marshalls an excellent cast.
The trouble is that Julia Jordan and Juliana Nash’s musical is barely exciting enough to fill an episode of ‘EastEnders’, let alone a 90-minute stage show.
